Introduction to Information Retrieval: Slides

Powerpoint slides are from the Stanford CS276 class and from the Stuttgart IIR class. Latex slides are from the Stuttgart IIR class. The latex slides are in latex beamer, so you need to know/learn latex to be able to modify them. You will need these beamer style files.
